title_rules.example: Budget Planner Printable | Monthly Finance Tracker | Minimalist Money Organizer PDF
best_practices: Front-load the most important keywords — Etsy weighs the beginning of titles more heavily
Use natural language that reads well to humans, not just search engines
Include the product format (PDF, printable, digital download, template)
Add style descriptors (minimalist, boho, modern, vintage) that buyers search for
Use pipes (|) or dashes (-) as separators for readability
Never repeat the same keyword more than twice
Include seasonal or occasion keywords when relevant (Christmas, wedding, back to school)
avoid: ALL CAPS words (except acronyms like PDF)
Misleading keywords unrelated to the product
Generic filler words that waste character space

strategy: Use all 13 available tags — every unused tag is a missed opportunity
Mix broad and specific keywords (e.g., 'planner' + 'weekly meal planner')
Include multi-word phrases as single tags — Etsy matches phrases, not individual words
Add seasonal and occasion tags when relevant
Use buyer-intent phrases (gift for her, new mom gift, teacher appreciation)
Include use-case tags (home office, dorm room, wedding planning)
Mirror the exact phrases buyers type in search
avoid: Repeating words already in the title — tags and title work together
Tags that don't match the actual product
Plural AND singular of the same word — Etsy handles stemming automatically

structure: Opening hook (first 160 chars appear in search preview)
best_practices: First 160 characters are critical — they appear in search results
Use natural keyword placement, not keyword stuffing
Include all file specifications (dimensions, format, resolution)
Add clear instructions for how to access and use the digital file
Mention compatible software (Adobe Reader, GoodNotes, Excel, etc.)
Include a FAQ section addressing common buyer questions
Add a personal touch about your design process or inspiration

recommended_set: Hero mockup showing product in use context
Lifestyle context shot (desk setup, wall display, etc.)

attribute_rules.description: Etsy product attributes (categories, occasion, style) improve search visibility
best_practices: Always select the most specific category available
Fill every available attribute field — completeness improves ranking
Set occasion tags for seasonal or event products
Choose style attributes that match buyer search behavior
Review and update attributes quarterly as Etsy adds new options
